caption: The drawing consists of a large square filled with a geometric pattern featuring primarily two colors: red and blue. The background is light blue and is overlaid with an evenly spaced grid of small red diamond shapes. On top of this background, a symmetrical design made up of thicker red lines and dots is arranged in an X- or cross-shaped formation radiating from the center, with each arm of the X composed of a series of segmented, textured red bands. These bands are outlined by small blue circular gaps. Within each quadrant created by the X shape, smaller red squares and rectangles filled with clusters of dots are present, aligning with the pattern’s geometric structure. The entire patterned square is centered within a larger off-white or light beige rectangular background. There is also a small signature-like mark in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Coverlet - Section of Reverse Side
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
